4.steps:
This testcase has three cases..
Case1:Deleting policy by clicking X button:
1- Login to management interface through a web browser
2- Go to Network/NAT Policy page
3- Click on Custom Policies and IPv6 Only radio buttons
4- Click X button at the end of an IPv6 NAT policy - Verify that policy gets deleted
Case2:Deleting policy by checking the checkbox for NAT Policy and then clicking Delete button:
1- Login to management interface through a web browser
2- Go to Network/NAT Policy page
3- Click on Custom Policies and IPv6 Only radio buttons
4- Check the checkbox for IPv6 NAT Policy and then click Delete button - Verify that policy gets deleted
Case3:Deleting all IPv6 NAT policies by clicking Delete All button:
1- Login to management interface through a web browser
2- Go to Network/NAT Policy page
3- Click on Custom Policies and IPv6 Only radio buttons
4- Click Delete All button - Verify that all the remaining custom IPv6 NAT policies get deleted
